grammar_title: 定语从句复习(Review of Relative Clauses)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 5 Review of Relative Clauses:关系代词(who/whom/which/that/whose)·关系副词与介词+which(where/when/why)·限制性vs非限制性(which/who不用that·which指代整句·as引导)。句子地道、诗歌文学主题、答案唯一(选项均为关系词,只一个成立)。

points.overview: 先行词指人用 who/whom、指物用 which/that;从句缺主语或宾语时用关系代词;whose 表所属(后接名词)。

points.point: 关系副词 where/when/why 与「介词+which/whom」
points.overview: 从句不缺主宾、只缺状语时:地点用 where、时间用 when、原因用 why;更正式或介词提前时用「介词+which/whom」(in which / on which / for which / to whom)。

points.point: 限制性 vs 非限制性 · which 指代整句 · as 引导
points.overview: 非限制性(有逗号)指人用 who、指物用 which,绝不用 that;which 可指代前面整个句子;as 引导非限制性从句表示「正如」(as is known)。

questions.stem: The poet ____ wrote this sonnet lived during the Victorian era.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poet 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: Tagore is the writer ____ won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
questions.explanation: 先行词 writer 指人、从句缺主语 → who(whom 只作宾语)。

questions.stem: The haiku ____ describes a falling blossom is very famous.
questions.explanation: 先行词 haiku 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: This is the nursery rhyme ____ my mother used to sing to me.
questions.explanation: 先行词 rhyme 指物、从句缺宾语(sing ___)→ that。

questions.stem: Langston Hughes was a poet ____ poems tell the story of black people.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poet,后接名词 poems 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: The cinquain ____ you wrote in class paints a clear picture.
questions.explanation: 先行词 cinquain 指物、从句缺宾语(wrote ___)→ that。

questions.stem: She is the only student ____ has memorised sixty ancient poems.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 only 修饰、指人作主语 → that(此时优先 that)。

questions.stem: Robert Browning was the man ____ Elizabeth finally married in secret.
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人、从句缺宾语(married ___)→ whom(亦可 who/that,此处只 whom 成立)。

questions.stem: A sonnet is a poem ____ contains exactly fourteen lines.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poem 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: The amateur ____ first read the poem aloud felt rather nervous.
questions.explanation: 先行词 amateur 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: I still keep the old book ____ cover has almost fallen apart.
questions.explanation: 先行词 book,后接名词 cover 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: The butterfly ____ the haiku describes lands on a single branch.
questions.explanation: 先行词 butterfly 指物、从句缺宾语(describes ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The Crescent Moon is the collection ____ made Tagore loved in China.
questions.explanation: 先行词 collection 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: He is a teacher ____ encourages every student to write a poem.
questions.explanation: 先行词 teacher 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The poems ____ we recited this morning were full of vivid imagery.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poems 指物、从句缺宾语(recited ___)→ that。

questions.stem: Elizabeth was a poet ____ verse won great success in 1844.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poet,后接名词 verse 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: The traveller ____ the lonely wife awaits never returns home.
questions.explanation: 先行词 traveller 指人、从句缺宾语(awaits ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: A limerick is a short poem ____ is usually silly and funny.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poem 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: The children ____ love this rhyme often repeat it again and again.
questions.explanation: 先行词 children 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: This is the very poem ____ first made me fall in love with verse.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 very 修饰、指物作主语 → that(此时优先 that)。

questions.stem: That is the classroom ____ our poetry contest was held last week.
questions.explanation: 先行词 classroom 表地点、从句完整(只缺地点状语)→ where。

questions.stem: 1844 was the year ____ Elizabeth's Poems brought her great success.
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Nobody knows the reason ____ the wind comes from somewhere far away.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: Italy was the country ____ the Brownings spent the rest of their lives.
questions.explanation: 先行词 country 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: I will never forget the day ____ I recited my first poem on stage.
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: The library is the place ____ I quietly read poetry every afternoon.
questions.explanation: 先行词 place 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: That is the manner in ____ a good poem should be read aloud.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 提前,后只能用 which → in which。

questions.stem: Spring is the season ____ cherry blossoms inspire countless haiku.
questions.explanation: 先行词 season 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: There must be a reason ____ this simple rhyme has lasted so long.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: Sonnets from the Portuguese is the book to ____ she owed her fame.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 提前、先行词指物 → to which。

questions.stem: This is the small room ____ the young poet wrote most of her verse.
questions.explanation: 先行词 room 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: He is the poet to ____ this whole collection of poems is dedicated.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 提前、先行词指人 → to whom。

questions.stem: That was the moment ____ the whole audience suddenly fell silent.
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Tell me the reason ____ free verse follows no regular rhythm at all.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: The branch on ____ the fallen blossom rests is painted in the haiku.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 提前、先行词指物 → on which。

questions.stem: The hill ____ the faithful wife stands has turned her into stone.
questions.explanation: 先行词 hill 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: Autumn is the time of year ____ we hold our school poetry festival.
questions.explanation: 先行词 time of year 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Calligraphy is the art form by ____ the poet's mood is also revealed.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 提前、先行词指物 → by which。

questions.stem: A free verse poem is one in ____ the poet has complete creative control.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 提前、先行词指物 → in which。

questions.stem: I cannot explain the reason ____ this poem always moves me to tears.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: Bai Juyi, ____ lived in the mid-Tang Dynasty, is one of China's greatest poets.
questions.explanation: 非限制性(逗号)、指人作主语 → who(非限制性绝不用 that)。

questions.stem: The haiku, ____ was translated from Japanese, shows a delicate butterfly.
questions.explanation: 非限制性(逗号)、指物 → which(绝不用 that)。

questions.stem: The poem rhymes perfectly, ____ makes it very pleasing to read aloud.
questions.explanation: 非限制性中 which 指代前面整个句子 → which。

questions.stem: Tagore, ____ poems Chinese readers love, wrote The Crescent Moon.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、后接名词 poems 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: She finished the whole collection in a week, ____ surprised her teacher.
questions.explanation: 非限制性中 which 指代前面整件事 → which。

questions.stem: Robert Browning, ____ Elizabeth admired deeply, became her husband.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指人作宾语 → whom(绝不用 that)。

questions.stem: ____ is well known, blank verse has no rhyme but a natural rhythm.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性从句,可置于句首表「正如」→ As is well known。

questions.stem: The Brownings moved to Italy, ____ is famous for its long literary history.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指物(Italy)作主语 → which(此处不缺地点状语,故非 where)。

questions.stem: Langston Hughes, ____ wrote 'Dream', spoke up for racial equality.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: He recited the sonnet beautifully, ____ won him the first prize.
questions.explanation: 非限制性中 which 指代前面整个句子 → which。

questions.stem: The nursery rhyme, ____ rhythm is simple, is loved by little children.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、后接名词 rhythm 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: ____ often happens in haiku, a single image carries the whole feeling.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性从句表「正如」,常置句首 → As often happens。

questions.stem: Elizabeth's father, ____ was a dominant man, refused to let her go.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The poem ends with a question, ____ leaves the reader thinking deeply.
questions.explanation: 非限制性中 which 指代前面整件事 → which。

questions.stem: Swinburne, ____ poem 'A Match' is short, compares love to a rose.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、后接名词 poem 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: The two poets wrote each other many letters, ____ sowed the seeds of love.
questions.explanation: 非限制性中 which 指代前面整件事 → which。

questions.stem: Wang Jian, ____ verse tells of a waiting wife, lived in the Tang Dynasty.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、后接名词 verse 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: ____ we all know, a good poem should be read aloud and with feeling.
questions.explanation: as 引导非限制性从句表「正如」,常置句首 → As we all know。

questions.stem: My favourite poet is Milne, ____ wrote the gentle poem 'Wind on the Hill'.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The class voted for her poem, ____ was clearly the best of them all.
questions.explanation: 非限制性、指物(her poem)作主语 → which。
